verdict.rationale: The Texas Workforce Commission is a state government agency portal for unemployment tax registration, wage reporting, and public workforce services. It is not an automation platform, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-defined automations is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any user-authored automation capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
